newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-TCorp to tender A$300 mln 2008 bonds Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-TCorp to tender A$300 mln 2008 bonds Tuesday.

text.p: New South Wales Treasury Corp said on Monday it would tender A$300 million of a new benchmark bond maturing March 1, 2008 on Tuesday morning.
Tender results for the bond, which will carry an eight percent coupon, would be announced by 10.20 a.m. (2320 GMT).

TCorp will also look to issue up to an additional A$200 million of the 2008 bonds either through accepting oversubscriptions in the tender, or through consolidating out of the 2001, 2004, 2006 TCorp bonds into the new issue.
Consolidations would commence from 11.00 a.m. (0000 GMT) on Tuesday, and terms of consolidation would be based on market conditions at the time.

The launch of the new benchmark bond is consistent with TCorp's stated objective of maintaining a minimum of A$12.0 billion of domestic bonds outstanding, given the pending maturity of the 12.5 percent April 1997 bond, of which there is about A$1.0 billion on issue.

As the new 2008 bond will have benchmark status, it is TCorp's intention to build the amount on issue towards the A$1.0 billion level over coming months, to ensure healthy levels of liquidity in the new bond.
